lines.1: We're almost at the school gate.
lines.2: Crab is sleeping like a log again today, so I left her behind.
lines.4: Sato is walking along at an easy pace.
lines.5: Let's see. That book I read yesterday said...
lines.6: If a girl blushes when you say, 'You're cute today too,' she is interested in you.
lines.7: All right. With Sato, I can pass it off as a joke.
lines.8: Eventually I'll try it on the Princess for real.
lines.10: When I call out to her...
lines.11: Sato's face lights up in a radiant smile.
lines.15: Even my voice comes out a little shrill.
lines.16: I really shouldn't say lines I'm not used to.
lines.21: 「Don't tease me first thing in the morning.」
lines.22: She pats me on the arm.
lines.24: Despite what she says, she looks happy.
lines.25: She even seems a little closer to me.
lines.27: Getting conceited now will only hurt me later.
lines.29: Just then, I feel a chill of murderous intent behind me.
lines.31: I throw myself sharply to the left.
lines.32: 「Tch. You dodged. Your reaction speed has improved.」
lines.33: The Princess stops her bicycle exactly where I had been standing.
lines.34: 「Please stop trying to run people over.」
lines.35: 「I was jealous because you and Yoppi looked so cozy.」
lines.38: 「It was a joke. You didn't have to deny it that coldly.」
lines.39: 「Ahaha. Did that actually hurt your feelings?」
lines.40: 「You there. Stop riding your bicycle recklessly.」
lines.41: The disciplinary committee's intervention ends our morning conversation.
lines.43: More than thirty minutes into lunch break.
lines.44: We have finished eating and are playing cards with our classmates.
lines.47: 「Guh, didn't get it past you... Damn it.」
lines.48: 「Being sleepy must be rough. Were you peeping into the girls' dorm again last night?」
lines.49: 「Don't casually make up such an outrageous lie!」
lines.50: 「Fukahire, at least make sure you are not discovered.」
lines.52: 「I-I think remarks like that are why nobody trusts you.」
lines.63: 「(He got to touch a girl. Lucky...)」
lines.64: 「The loser must ring the Director's doorbell and run away.」
lines.65: 「Sounds good. Let's do it. Fukahire will lose anyway.」
lines.66: 「That was close. Glad I got out.」
lines.67: 「Sato, aren't you good at games involving wagers?」
lines.68: 「No. I'm just desperate not to lose.」
lines.69: Having gone out, Sato and I chat at our leisure.
lines.76: 「Ringing my doorbell and running away? How amusing. I can sense your energy, so hiding is pointless.」
lines.77: 「It ain't like that, Director! It was a penalty, so I had no choice...」
